definition: Replacing some feed-forward blocks with large learned key-value lookup tables, adding parameters that store facts without adding per-token FLOPs, and in newer designs (Titans-style) learning what to memorize at test time.
details: Replacing some feed-forward blocks with large learned key-value lookup tables, adding parameters that store facts without adding per-token FLOPs, and in newer designs (Titans-style) learning what to memorize at test time. A revival of product-key memory aimed at separating knowledge storage from computation.

explainer.lead: Replacing some feed-forward blocks with large learned key-value lookup tables, adding parameters that store facts without adding per-token FLOPs; newer Titans-style designs learn what to memorize at test time. It revives product-key memory to separate knowledge storage from computation.

tiers.eli5: Instead of doing more arithmetic for every word, the model looks facts up in a huge learned index.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers swap some feed-forward blocks for large key-value lookup tables to add fact storage without per-token FLOPs, and in newer designs learn what to memorize at test time.

explainer.example: A model stores factual associations in a lookup table memory layer so recalling them costs no extra per-token computation.
